title: The Righteous Will Live by Faith
question: Why do three New Testament writers all reach for this one line?
blurb: A single sentence from a minor prophet turns up at the heart of the New Testament. Follow it.

nodes.content: Why do three New Testament writers all reach for this one line?

nodes.verseText: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright—but the righteous will live by faith—
yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
